prompt: Convert $4$ yards to feet. ($1$ yd $= 3$ ft)
hint: Yards are bigger than feet. When you switch to a smaller unit, you need more of them to cover the same length.

hints.text: Yards are bigger than feet. When you switch to a smaller unit, you need more of them to cover the same length.
One yard is $3$ feet, so $4$ yards is four groups of $3$ feet: work out $4 \times 3$.
$4 \times 3 = 12$, so a length of $4$ yards is $12$ feet.

explanation: Use the fact given in the problem: $1$ yard is the same length as $3$ feet.
Each of the $4$ yards becomes $3$ feet, so multiply the yards by $3$.
Four groups of three feet make $4 \times 3 = 12$ feet.
Four yards are the same length as $12$ feet.
